name: Thistlefur Hold
summary: Corruption has turned the furbolgs of Thistlefur Hold against every outsider who draws near. Their cavern den lies at the northern end of Thistlefur Village in west-central Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Corrupted Den
sections.body: Thistlefur Hold lies at the northern end of Thistlefur Village, at the heart of the Thistlefur tribe's territory. Corruption has driven its furbolgs mad, and they attack travelers and neighbors who draw near. In the winding caverns, the tribe hoards scavenged relics, including troll charms sought by the Darkspear. Captives are kept in wooden cages deep within, among them Ruul Snowhoof, a tauren brave.

faq.answer: Thistlefur Hold lies beneath the northern end of Thistlefur Village in west-central Ashenvale. Its caverns hold the greatest number of hostile Thistlefur furbolgs.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs in Thistlefur Hold hostile?
faq.answer: Corruption has twisted the minds of the Thistlefur furbolgs and driven them to attack outsiders.

faq.q: Who is trapped inside the hold?
faq.answer: Ruul Snowhoof, a tauren brave, is held in a wooden cage deep in the caverns. Horde champions seek to free him.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in Thistlefur Hold?
faq.answer: The Horde seeks to free the captured tauren Ruul Snowhoof and recover the troll charms the furbolgs have hoarded in the caverns.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face two aims in Thistlefur Hold: free Ruul Snowhoof and recover the troll charms the furbolgs have hoarded.
As a druid, you see the Thistlefur furbolgs' corruption and madness as a tragedy. Their fall shows how nature's guardians in Ashenvale can be corrupted.
